claims.title: Directed Euler tours: a paid bidirected sampler and the remaining adaptive directed-law gap

quoted_fields.interface: Explicit strongly connected directed Eulerian multigraph, n vertices,m distinguishable arcs, rational0<epsilon<=1/2, complete binary input B, canonical cyclic tour with smallest-labelled arc first. The proved sampler additionally requires opposite arc multiplicities agree for each distinct vertex pair. Empty singleton and loop-only singleton cases are explicit.
quoted_fields.failure: Imported skew-determinantal mixing and pointwise permutation-gadget results are credited at the root-read version, not new Capital proofs or world-best/novelty claims. The constant-fibre/TV/finite-bit compositions are completed scoped interfaces; no full nearlinear backend or general lower bound is proved. Minimum-cost arborescence optimization is not sampling. A 2021 parallel arborescence result was seen only at record/abstract scope and no unread work-bound theorem is imported. All source/access/transfer holds and native-memory limits persist. CONTINUATION: The full-class asymmetric operation and any general impossibility result remain unproved. BEST and mature undirected tree/matroid mixing are credited once. Producer Python frequencies are retained but not executed by Capital. Fixed-query sketch correctness does not imply the adaptive joint law. Equal arc marginals or one expected contraction are not uniform-tree TV. Current source-version contracts are root-reported governing reads, not new Capital primary acquisition.
